items.title: Does the excluded third option actually help?
items.description: The false dichotomy in L2 was "commit every week, or admit it's over" — a reminder text was one of the excluded alternatives. Based on last Friday's dip (2 of 6 missed, a 33% miss rate), drag the slider to see how much a reminder text would need to cut that miss rate by to matter, and what attendance it would produce.

params.name: reminderEffectiveness
params.label: Reduction in miss rate from a reminder text

items.compute: const baseMissRate = 2 / 6; const reducedMissRate = baseMissRate * (1 - params.reminderEffectiveness / 100); const expectedAttendance = Math.round((6 - reducedMissRate * 6) * 10) / 10; return { expectedAttendance };
